title: Concept: Composer repository of type vcs or git
description: composer.json declares a repository that clones code instead of reading a package index, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a repository that clones code instead of reading a package index.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a repository that clones code instead of reading a package index.
